recommendations.regimenLabel: Controlled oxygen + nebulised bronchodilators + oral corticosteroid
steps: Antibiotics only if increased purulent sputum / consolidation / ventilatory support.
NIV for persistent respiratory acidosis (pH <7.35 with hypercapnia).

drugRefs.why: Relieves bronchospasm and airflow limitation in the exacerbation.
Combined with salbutamol for additive bronchodilation in COPD exacerbations.
Shortens recovery, improves lung function and reduces relapse; a short 5-day course is standard.

refs: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e — Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
GOLD Report — Management of Exacerbations of COPD

confirm: Increased dyspnoea/sputum/wheeze in known COPD without convincing infection. Assess for CO2 retention.
disposition: Admit if hypoxic/acidotic; ICU/NIV if failing.
